title: Machine learning selects an exploratory mitochondrial gene signature in diabetic retinopathy
summary: Differential expression, GSEA and WGCNA on two GEO diabetic retinopathy datasets (GSE102485, GSE60436) yielded 13 core mitochondria-related genes; LASSO regression and SVM-RFE selected a five-gene diagnostic model (CKMT1A, SLC25A27, SHMT2, ALDH1L1, CYCS) with a mean AUC of 0.89 in internal 10-fold cross-validation. All five genes changed expression in high-glucose-treated human retinal microvascular endothelial cells (RT-qPCR, western blot). The authors state the signature is only internally validated and requires independent cohorts; the cell experiment tests expression changes, not diagnostic performance.
ai_technology: LASSO regression and support vector machine recursive feature elimination select the diagnostic genes from public transcriptomes.
organization: The Affiliated Hospital to Changchun University of Chinese Medicine, Changchun University of Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: Signature evaluated by internal 10-fold cross-validation on GEO data; expression of the five genes measured in a high-glucose human retinal endothelial cell model.
evidence.unknown: No independent patient cohort; diagnostic performance likely optimistic; no functional knockdown or clinical test; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO and SVM-RFE selected the five genes whose expression was then checked experimentally.

source_review.scope: Independent review: full abstract and affiliations from OpenAlex, Crossref dates, OpenAlex title search for earlier versions; publisher full text not accessed.
